purpose: Independently reproduce and qualify the planar parabolic-Lagrange normal-variational nonintegrability obstruction that WP4-LIFT-NI-v2 previously consumed as an external premise.
goal: Starting from the declared translation- and rotation-reduced positive-mass Newtonian Hamiltonian at normalized nonzero angular momentum, derive the exact parabolic Lagrange phase curve, variational system, Whittaker energy-shell reduction, 4x4 Fuchsian normal variational equation, residue spectra, and a non-Abelian differential-Galois identity-component certificate for the complete positive-mass parameter domain.
evidence_boundary: A PASS is a project-owned exact reproduction of the local planar Morales-Ramis obstruction. It starts from the explicitly declared reduced Newtonian Hamiltonian and independently differentiates it; it does not independently reconstruct every canonical translation/rotation coordinate map from the unreduced 18-dimensional state. It proves no absence of individual additional first integrals, no non-meromorphic obstruction, no zero-angular-momentum theorem, no spatial theorem without the separately qualified WP4-LIFT-NI-v3 transfer, no global orbit classification, no catalogue completeness, and no statement about triple collision.

wp4_mr_v2.role: Completed external theorem application retained as comparison evidence, not used as the reproduction proof.

wp4_lift_v2.role: Identifies the external premise to be replaced; its completed evidence remains unchanged.

model.masses: m1>0, m2>0, m3=1 after positive common-mass scaling; all finite positive triples are represented.
model.gravity_and_momentum: G=1 and fixed nonzero angular momentum k=1 after the standard nonzero scaling used in the pinned reduced Hamiltonian.
model.particular_solution: The zero-energy parabolic Lagrange equilateral phase curve in the source convention, parametrized by q and p or w=p*q.
model.normal_system: The four-dimensional Whittaker energy-shell normal variational equation in y=(q2,q3,p2,p3), transformed by the declared rational Fuchs gauge.
model.mass_invariant: sigma=(m1*m2+m1+m2)/(m1+m2+1)^2, equivalently the symmetric three-mass invariant before m3 normalization.

theorem_obligations.R1_reduced_hamiltonian: Represent the declared reduced Newtonian Hamiltonian exactly and verify its source convention term by term.
theorem_obligations.R2_lagrange_phase_curve: Derive the equilateral configuration and momentum parametrization, verify H=0 and all six Hamilton equations, and derive q(w) and dq/dw exactly.
theorem_obligations.R3_whittaker_reduction: Derive the implicit energy-shell Hamiltonian K=-p1 and its exact Hessian formula from H=0; obtain the 4x4 normal variational system without importing a published coefficient matrix.
theorem_obligations.R4_fuchs_gauge: Apply the declared meromorphic gauge and prove that the transformed system has exactly one real turning singularity, two complex collision singularities, and infinity, with only simple poles.
theorem_obligations.R5_finite_residues: Prove the real turning residue characteristic polynomial is lambda^2*(lambda+1)^2 and each complex collision residue characteristic polynomial is lambda*(lambda-1)*(lambda+1)*(lambda+2).
theorem_obligations.R6_infinity_residue: Prove the infinity residue characteristic polynomial is lambda^4-6*lambda^3+7*lambda^2+6*lambda+(27*sigma-8), exactly for symbolic positive masses.
theorem_obligations.R7_positive_mass_domain: Prove 0<sigma<=1/3 for every finite positive mass triple and audit all boundary and equality cases without numerical tolerance.
theorem_obligations.R8_nonabelian_certificate: Use integer finite exponents, finite unipotent monodromies, identity-component containment, the fundamental-group product relation, and the infinity spectrum to prove the differential-Galois identity component is non-Abelian for every 0<sigma<=1/3.
theorem_obligations.R9_morales_ramis_application: Apply the pinned Morales-Ramis necessary condition only to the declared complex meromorphic Liouville-integrability model and local phase-curve neighborhood.
theorem_obligations.R10_source_equivalence_and_boundary: Prove exact equivalence of variables, singular points, residue spectra, infinity exponent polynomial, and conclusion to the pinned primary evidence; state every nonclaim.

independent_validation.production: A pure-Python exact rational certificate over Fraction proves the mass-domain, residue-polynomial, integer-exponent, infinity non-unipotence, and group-theoretic implication without importing SymPy or the reference implementation.
independent_validation.reference: A source-disjoint SymPy program differentiates the reduced Hamiltonian, constructs the Lagrange curve and Whittaker Hessian, performs the Fuchs gauge, and computes exact residues and characteristic polynomials.
independent_validation.generic_replay: At least one exact computation over Q(sqrt(3),i)(m1,m2) must prove the generic residue identities as rational-function identities.
independent_validation.specializations: At least two distinct exact positive rational mass pairs, including equal masses, must independently reproduce all residue spectra.

domain_certificate.unipotence_contradiction: If all infinity monodromy eigenvalues were one, two exponent roots would be integers. Their odd transforms x=2*lambda1-3 and y=2*lambda2-3 would satisfy x^2+y^2=26. The only odd-square decomposition is {1,25}, which forces sigma=0, contradicting positive masses.
domain_certificate.exception_policy: The separate set concerns possible polynomial invariants of the first NVE and never suspends the complete-integrability obstruction.

adversarial_controls: Reject zero, negative, nonfinite, and malformed masses.
Detect any changed coefficient in the infinity polynomial.
Reject sigma=0 as a positive-mass case.
Reject a proof with the identity-component containment premise removed.
Reject a proof with the finite-monodromy commutation implication removed.
Reject importing the production implementation from the reference derivation.

source_policy.original_nve_source: Tsygvintsev 2001 supplies the reduced Hamiltonian convention, parabolic Lagrange curve, Fuchsian NVE, and residue/exponent comparison target.
source_policy.independent_published_application: Boucher-Weil supplies a separately published planar three-body Morales-Ramis conclusion for comparison only.
source_policy.foundational_theorem: Morales-Ruiz and Ramis 2001 supplies the necessary Abelian identity-component condition.
source_policy.copyright_boundary: Only metadata, hashes, and short machine-checked text contracts are stored; source PDFs are not redistributed.

decision_policy.PASS: Every locked source, prerequisite, derivation, exact-identity, domain, group-theoretic, independent-reference, adversarial-control, proof-coverage, and boundary gate passes under a frozen implementation.
decision_policy.FAIL: Any source mismatch, imported published coefficient matrix, symbolic mismatch, unresolved positive-mass case, group implication gap, implementation coupling, negative-control escape, or boundary violation fails v1 and requires a successor.
decision_policy.AUTHORIZED_CLAIM: The project independently reproduces, from the declared reduced Newtonian Hamiltonian and exact parabolic Lagrange phase curve, a 4x4 Fuchsian normal variational equation whose differential-Galois identity component is non-Abelian for every finite positive mass triple. By the pinned Morales-Ramis theorem, the declared translation- and rotation-reduced planar positive-mass Newtonian three-body Hamiltonian at fixed nonzero angular momentum is not completely integrable by meromorphic first integrals in a complex neighborhood of that phase curve.
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_SHORT_CLAIM: The three-body problem has no integrals.
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_INDEPENDENCE_CLAIM: The project independently rederived every canonical reduction from the unreduced 18-dimensional Hamiltonian.
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_GLOBAL_CLAIM: The local phase-curve obstruction classifies all trajectories or all regularity classes.

invalidation: Any changed theorem statement, Hamiltonian convention, phase curve, gauge, source payload, prerequisite, domain argument, proof obligation, control, decision rule, or frozen implementation invalidates v1. A failed frozen execution remains FAIL.
